name: Pull Request Review
description: Review a concrete diff through context, correctness, conditional security and architecture checks, and a merge recommendation.
approval_boundaries: Do not edit reviewed files or submit review state without authorization.

phases.name: Review context
phases.instructions: Identify requested behavior, diff scope, repository rules, and validation evidence.

phases.name: Correctness review
phases.instructions: Review correctness, regressions, maintainability, and missing tests.

phases.name: Conditional security review
phases.instructions: Assess security-sensitive surfaces when present; otherwise record not applicable.

phases.name: Conditional architecture review
phases.instructions: Assess boundary and dependency changes when present; otherwise record not applicable.

phases.name: Review recommendation
phases.instructions: Reconcile findings, validation, risks, and readiness into a recommendation.
